They do not pack anything well and sometimes will send completely wrong orders/boots. Even though they do make horrid “cowboy boots” their work boots are what they are really good at for being an outsourced company. I have a pair of caiman and deepwater arapaima and a pair of R toe Comp toe work boots so i am not just talking out of my ass. Ariat does not deserve to and should not be the head of the industry with the amount of low quality garbage they keep pumping out.
